purpose: Independent second public raw-EEG transport and Kotlin-vs-Python parity test for the already frozen v0.7 coupling-field operator. No parameter may be changed in response to the numerical outcome.

source.dataset: CogWear: Can we detect cognitive effort with consumer-grade wearables?
source.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License v1.0
source.checksum_policy: At runtime, extract the SHA-256 for the exact source path from the versioned PhysioNet SHA256SUMS.txt and require the downloaded file to match before analysis.
source.condition_definition: Three-minute relaxed baseline with no task, as documented by CogWear.

input_mapping.record_policy: Use every non-empty CSV record after the header. A non-empty record with fewer than 25 columns is a hard failure.
input_mapping.raw_columns_one_based_documentation: Columns 22-25 are raw TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10 in microvolts according to CogWear description.csv.
input_mapping.non_numeric_raw_cell_policy: Represent an empty or otherwise non-numeric raw cell as NaN; the frozen v0.7 engine then applies its existing non-finite-to-zero cleaning. No rows are selected or removed based on signal values.
input_mapping.channel_order_for_engine: The engine sorts labels lexicographically, yielding AF7, AF8, TP10, TP9.

frozen_operator.filter: existing v0.7 biquad high-pass/low-pass path; for 256 Hz this is 1-40 Hz
frozen_operator.coarse_grain: existing deterministic greedy descending PLV*NMI bundle weight

parity_gate.python_oracle: Reuse the independent mathematical implementation in tools/validation/v07_reference.py; add only a CogWear CSV input adapter and generic output manifest for this source.
parity_gate.kotlin_engine: Call the unchanged CouplingFieldV07Engine on the same four raw channels and frozen 256 Hz sample rate.
parity_gate.comparison: Compare all exported scale values and all pair values, including pair ordering and node labels.
required_invariants: engine and signal-engine Git blob identities unchanged
source channel labels AF7, AF8, TP10, TP9

interpretation_guardrails: No numerical result from this dataset may be used to retune v0.7.
A green parity result validates reproducible software transport on a second independent public recording; it does not establish universality, diagnosis, biomarker validity or causality.
Q remains a normalized coupling-loss proxy, not physical power.
chi_dyn remains a ridge VAR(1) spectral-radius coordinate, not a calibrated L/C ratio.
This four-channel 4->2->1 run is not by itself a strong scale-invariance test because it contains only two non-terminal pairwise scales.
